column1: however  derived  shall  be  applied  solely  towards  the

column2: (1) The seal of the Corporation shall not be affixed

column1: to any instrument whatsoever, except in the presence of two

column2: (2) The seal of the Corporation shall be in the custody of

column2: (1) If upon the dissolution of the Corporation there

column1: remains after the satisfaction of all its debts and liabilities,
any  property  whatsoever,  such  property  shall  not  be

be given or transferred to any other institution having objects
similar  to  those  of  the  Corporation,  and  which  is  by  the
rules thereof,  prohibited from distributing any income or
property among its members.

column2: (2)  For  the  purposes  of  subsection  (1)  the  appropriate
